```{r}
# Beautiful Palmer Penguins Visualization
# Install and load required packages

library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load the penguins dataset
data(penguins)

# Create a beautiful scatter plot
penguins %>%
  filter(!is.na(bill_length_mm), !is.na(flipper_length_mm)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
             y = flipper_length_mm, 
             color = species,
             shape = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Adelie" = "#FF6B35",
                                 "Chinstrap" = "#4ECDC4",
                                 "Gentoo" = "#95389E")) +
  labs(title = "Palmer Penguins: Bill Length vs Flipper Length",
       subtitle = "Exploring morphological differences across three penguin species",
       x = "Bill Length (mm)",
       y = "Flipper Length (mm)",
       color = "Species",
       shape = "Species",
       caption = "Data: Palmer Station LTER | Visualization: R + ggplot2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

# Display summary statistics
cat("\n=== Dataset Summary ===\n")
penguins %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    avg_bill_length = round(mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    avg_flipper_length = round(mean(flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) %>%
  print()
```
